preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 6 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range.
The input forms a tree with exactly n-1 edges.
The edges form a connected undirected graph (tree).

postconditions.expression: len(output_pairs) == 2 and all(len(pair) == 2 for pair in output_pairs)
postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly two pairs of vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for pair in output_pairs for x, y in pair)
postconditions.description: All vertices in the output pairs are within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(x != y for pair in output_pairs for x, y in pair)
postconditions.description: Each pair consists of distinct vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(x1 != x2 and x1 != y2 and y1 != x2 and y1 != y2 for (x1, y1), (x2, y2) in combinations(output_pairs, 2))
postconditions.description: All four vertices in the two pairs are distinct.

postconditions.expression: not any(v in path(x1, y1) for v in [x2, y2]) and not any(v in path(x2, y2) for v in [x1, y1])
postconditions.description: Neither vertex of one pair lies on the simple path of the other pair.
The two paths share at least two common vertices.
The total length of the two paths is maximized among all valid pairs.
The number of common vertices between the two paths is maximized among all valid pairs with the same total length.
